title: Fabrication and characterization of electrospun polycaprolactone/Urechis unicinctus derived-ECM composite scaffolds for small-diameter vascular grafts
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31060-31075
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04406E, Paper

Electrospun PCL/Urechis unicinctus-derived ECM scaffolds unite elastic recovery with pro-endothelial bioactivity, accelerating tube formation and highlighting their promise as marine-derived candidates for small-diameter vascular grafts.
